content.short: KuCoin is a centralized crypto exchange for buying, selling, storing, and trading assets across global markets.
content.description: KuCoin is a global exchange focused on trading access, account security, proof-of-reserves messaging, and broad asset support. TON users encounter it as a centralized venue for market access rather than as an on-chain TON protocol. KuCoin is a secure cryptocurrency exchange that makes it easier to buy, sell, and store cryptocurrencies like BTC, ETH, KCS, SHIB, DOGE, Gari etc. Crypto Exchange | Bitcoin Exchange | Bitcoin Trading | KuCoin Trust First. For TON users, it supports the decisions and account actions that happen around buying, selling, or monitoring assets.
